translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Lukaŋo Yesu Wane Donkisi Teopilus Qe Mange
O, Teopilus suainene. Mokaka ŋei loutne eŋe Anutuŋo kine kine wele maki keuno wakonge, ea wane don kisi tegoke more qekoi.
Don kisi yewa mo ŋei weneŋ osop ge more, deene qomineŋo alakan wakongi, kinerop ka detka okangoi, eŋe ŋedangoi. Ŋei eao kine kine one more, Anutu wane biŋek don ra qelaŋangoi.
Pakimo noŋo yalewaka mo kino ŋineka kine kine wakone sarike, ea wane bororom ra qeson okane, kine dere detluk kawarewe, pakimo koso ge iwa sorok sorok qetitike qe ginmaile.
Pakimo, ge iwa dapore more, iwa yale detnom qoeake. Eŋe kito gingoi, yewa mo kine kine wele!
Aŋeloŋo Yohane Wakoniakane Zekaraia Olatke
Naso Herot eŋe Yuda kepeo ŋei waom geke, yewao mosop ŋei mane geke, eŋetine Zekaraia, eŋe mosop ŋei Abiya wane tegoo ŋine. Ŋanominane eŋetne Elizabet, eŋe yalewaka mosop ŋei tego eŋano ŋine.
Ere Anutu wane kaitko gegeetne koboboine geuk paki, Waom wane ra rokop donine koropka tewekkoik.
Elizabet eŋe qaton gekane ere medewekopetne midaine ge mage, ŋei ŋerep sele okangoik.
Naso maneo, Zekaraia wane nasoo, eŋe Anutu wane Bakom Urumgo urataine mayakane sarike.
Sarikiso, mosop ŋei korop urataine welaine welaine maikei wane okane weneŋ sarikoi, pakiso, Zekaraia eŋe kopu qounerop kiwakeakane rakauso Anutu Wane Bakom Urum kotino waketke.
Waket more, kopu qounerop kiwakki, so ŋei ŋerep magu eŋe ŋadino Anutu meŋenka gekoi.
Pakiso, Waom wane aŋelo maneŋo wakone more, kopu qounerop kiwa kiwak, ea wane zake nat paromino wongoken yewa okorake.
Okorakiso, Zekaraiaŋo kaki paki qise more, ikki kito qokkake.
Yale okangimo, aŋeloŋo iwa yale olatke, “Zekaraia, ge mi kaetgangep! Anutuŋo meŋe meŋenŋone mo detke, ea wane mo ŋanomŋone Elizabetŋo medep ŋatke more mayake, eŋane eŋetine Yohane orakene.
Ge eŋane wet pesek dere more bakom kitokene, so ŋei ŋerep korop eŋe yalewaka wakongi dere more simile oniake!
Eŋe Waom wane kaitko ŋei suaine okane geake, eŋe wain so doku togole mi neake. Eŋe medep abubuka paki Asu Koboboineŋo eŋane kotino ket more geake.
Pakimo, eŋe Israel ŋei ŋerep korop mainongi, koso zinge more Waomene Anutu, kaitno kitokei.

Anutu wane don saeŋine rara ŋei, Elaiya wano Asu so zonom pake, rokop yalewaka pa mangi, eŋe Waom alakane geake, pakimo, ŋei ŋerep suaine so medep nigatne eŋane wetene maton tolaki weku okaniake, so wet togon ŋei eŋe mainongi, koboboine eŋane numao waketkei. Yale okangimo, eŋe Waom wane ŋei ŋerep korop maki eweke more gekei.”
Rakimo, Zekaraiaŋo aŋelo olale rake, “Na daleo don iwa ramaine, ea detpe wele okaniake? Na mo ŋei sele okanmaile, so ŋanomne eŋe yalewaka sele okanmaike.”
Rakimo, aŋeloŋo iwa yale olatke, “Na Gabriel, na Anutu wane kaitko ge okanmaile, oŋo talenangi sari, qom menaŋ don iwa golatmaile.
Pakimo, ge naŋane don detnom wele mi okangi, detlukmaine, ea wane turuŋine ge qelaŋ okane more, don raraŋone midaine genom, don golatmaile, iwa wele wakoniake.”
Zekaraia eŋe Anutu wane Bakom Urumgo yale okane geki, ŋei ŋerep eŋe naso kiroine tomaka more kinane ŋaŋaekoi.

Zakaria eŋe Anutu wane Bakom Urumgo ŋine saket more don edaniakane ŋaŋaeke, ea wane eŋe mo wetke rakoi, eŋe tanik mane Anutu wane Bakom Urumgo wakongi kake. Pakiso, eŋe don edaniakane ŋaŋaeso metineŋoka kait masi ma okanonge.
Yale okane geki urumgo urata mama nasoine qoekiso, Zakariaŋo matino zinge arike.
Pakiso ŋado ŋanomine Elizabet eŋe medep ŋatkeke. Ŋatke more, siu siuko geki, meso mete mane qoekiso rake,
“Waomŋo naso motke, yewa bomileki qesiŋnane more, gamune yewa ŋei ŋerep eŋane kaiteno ŋine ma biraki ariake!”
Aŋeloŋo Yesu Wakoniakane Maria Olatke
Meso 6 qoekiso, Anutuŋo aŋelo Gabriel talekaki, Galili kepeo Nazaret matko arike.
Eŋe ari more ŋerep natewen mane eŋetne Maria, ŋei mane eŋetne Yosep, eŋane biŋek qeu geke, eŋano lotkeke, Yosep eŋe ŋei waom Dawit wane tutule.
Pakimo, aŋeloŋo Maria wano wakone more rake, “Peamŋo gerop payake! Waomŋo gerop gemaike so suaineka mosop ganmaike!”
Aŋeloŋo don yale rakimo, Mariaŋo detki qekaki wetneŋo iwa yale wetkeke, “Don iwa onoka wane nolatmaike?”
Pakimo, aŋeloŋo olale rake, “Maria ge misuk kaet gangep, Anutuŋo gangi menaŋmaike.
Detmaine, ge medep ŋatke more manom paki, eŋetne Yesu orakene.
Eŋe baŋ ŋei kakapa suaine okaniake, pakimo, eŋe baŋ eŋetine qeliwo Anutu Wawaine eŋane Medep orakei. Pakimo, baŋ Waom Anutuŋo ŋaboine Dawit yale, ŋei waom birakaki geake.
Ge more, Yakop wane ŋosa wili wiliine eŋane ŋei waom okane, qoi qoine midaine wareone tako rakot ge ari more geake!”
Rakimo, Mariaŋo aŋelo iwa yale olatke, “Na natewen, ŋeirop mane mi gemaile, yalinanemo ge don ramaine, yewa daleo wele mosiake?”

Aŋeloŋo done turuŋine mainge rake, “Asu Koboboineŋo geŋane kutko kesiake, so Anutu wane zonomŋo geŋano ket more qesiŋ ganiake, kine yalewa wane medep koboboine maikene, eŋane eŋetne baŋ Anutu wane Medep orakei.
Detmaine, kimaŋone Elizabet eŋe ŋerep seleŋo medep ŋatke geki, meso 6 okanmaike. Eŋe ŋerep qaton, yale ora ra okanmami, ŋo eŋe siluŋ medep ŋatkemaike.
Anutuŋo kine kine mane okaniakane mi qekayake.”
Rakiso, Mariaŋo rake, “Na waom wane qelit ŋerep, ea wane ge don ramaine, yale okannaniake.” Yale rakiso, aŋeloŋo arike.
Mariaŋo Ari Elizabet Kulitka Ari Kake
Maria eŋe geki, mi azongi ikopka eweke more, Yuda kepe bonagaino mat mane metke, yewa arike.
Ari lotke more, Zekaraia wane matko wa more, so Elizabet kaki pakiso, oi bakom okankake.
Elizabetŋo Maria wane oi bakom yewa dere metkiso, medepŋo yewaka moea ŋatino uŋap make, pakiso Asu Koboboineŋo Elizabet wane kotino watkeke.
Pakiso, Elizabetŋo mawaka so don iwa yale rake, “Ŋerep kimaze, geŋane mosop korop yewaŋo ŋerep natne eŋe yuan onwaremaike, so medep ŋatŋono metmaike, eŋe yalewaka mosop korop.
Onoka maepnane, Waomnane nagaineŋo nanikenane sarimaine?
Oi bakom okan nannom, ketno ketki ŋatno medepŋo uŋap mamaike, so bakom kitomaike.
Ge wet pesek suaine okanmaine, ge Waom wane biŋek don golatke, yewa detnom wele okange, ea wane wele geŋano wakoniake.”
Maria Wane Bakom Eŋet
Mariaŋo rake,

content.text: “Qomneŋo Waom mawa kamaike,

Anutuŋo mauluk nanmaike, eŋe qelit ŋerep meine ket qeqine naŋane wetkemaike, ea wane oŋa oŋaneŋo wet pesek okanmaike. Togole welaine Anutuŋo masi kakapa naŋano mamaike, ea wane ukude so baŋ ŋado ŋei ŋerep kepe korop maguine maguine noramaŋkei, ‘Anutuŋo mosop gange.’ Anutu ea eŋane eŋetine koboboine.
Ŋei ŋerep eŋe Anutu ewino kito okanmami, eŋe eŋano so eŋane doko ŋosa wili wiliene wet maep ebon mageake.
Eŋe kabirimine togogoleka bira more, ŋei wawaine ge okanmami, esopongi yau yaup ari okanmami.
Eŋe ŋei waom togogole met meteno ŋine maket biraone more, ŋei ketlele gemami, eŋe ebu wa meŋo biraon okanmaike.
Bodi so aboŋene midaine ge okanmami, eŋe kine kine mayakatne qe watke ebon okanmaike. Ŋo riwe morian so aboŋenerop ge okanmami, eŋe yemo esopongi, eŋe meteenoka qeliŋka ari okanmami.
Eŋe ra rokop donine ŋabokopze eŋano ra togoleke, yewa ware kamaike, eŋe qelit ŋeiine Israel qesiŋ kamaike.
Eŋe ŋaboze Abraham so eŋane doko ŋosa wili wilikoune, eŋano wet maep ebone ariake.”

content: Maria eŋe meso karewe Elizabet korop geki, pakiso koso zinge matino arike.
Yohane Wakonge
Elizabet eŋe nasoine bomilekiso, medep ŋei make.
Pakiso, Elizabet matkoune so weŋem sotawekoune eŋe kisiine ea dere so Waomŋo wet maepinane kine eŋano ma wakonge, ea wane dere so eŋerop weneŋ bakom kitokoi.
Kaiwe urata mama 8 qoekiso, eŋe lewageu, medepinane yaine solaine kitatkoi, pakiso, medep wane eŋetne magaine Zekaraia wasekakei wane rakoi.
Rauso, nagaineŋo kitatone more rake, “Mida! Eŋetine Yohane orakene.”
Yale rakiso, eŋe olale rakoi, “Mame asokopŋone eŋane wase wase eŋet mane yale mi pamaike!”
Ra kito qok yale okanmage, so magaine meteŋoka kait masi okanka more, medep eŋetne orayakane qesonkakoi.
Pakiso, Zekaraia eŋe tape wane raki manbiso, iwa yale qeke, “Eŋetine Yohane.” Pakiso, eŋe korop qise nagukoi!
Mi azongiso, Zekaraia maine mo menaŋge, paki don raraine wakongiso, Anutu eŋetine ma wakake.
Pakiso, mat loli lolik ŋei ŋerep gekoi, eŋe don kisi yewa detpi kaetonge. So Yuda kepe meŋoino mat mere arike, yewao don kisi yewa weneŋ aŋaŋo aŋa auye okan warekoi.
Don kisi detkoi, ŋei ŋerep yewa eŋe don kisi yewa wetke ge more qesone rakoi, “Medep yaline sua more daleo okaniake?” Eŋe mo detkoi, Waom wane zonomŋo mo kutno wa pake.
Zekaraiaŋo Don Naŋengo Rake
Asu Koboboineŋo Yohane magaine Zekaraia wane kotino ket watkeke, paki eŋe Anutu ma waka more, iwa yale rake,

content.text: “Ŋene Waom ma wakaŋem, Israel wane Anutu! Eŋe sariki paki, ŋei ŋerewekoune qesiŋ onmaike, eŋe koso siwot onmaike.
Qelit medeune Dawit wane ŋabokoune ŋenane keuo ŋine, ŋei togogole mane ma wakonkaki, oŋo baŋ maulukoniake.
Eŋe mokaka qelit ŋeikoune koboboine edangi, don ŋenzo ra gekoi,
baŋ ŋabokopze eŋane meteeno ŋine koso mainŋongi zingekene, so qaisikŋon okanmami, eŋane meteeno ŋine makok ŋoniake.
Ŋabokopze eŋerop tako rakot togon koboboine okaniakane detongi, paki masi wet maep mayakatne eŋano okanoniake.
Eŋe ŋaboze Abraham ra togole mangane, ŋabakopze eŋano ŋine makok ŋoniake.
So detŋongi, kaetze midaine qelitine qekene.
Paki, eŋane kaitko kepeo gekene, rokop naso baŋem sot turuŋze midaine koboboine gekene.
Medepne, ge eŋe baŋ Anutu Wawainane qelit ŋei gorakei, goŋo baŋ Waom wane ŋetne kisage alakangene, eŋane numaine lapongenane.
Goŋo baŋ ŋei ŋerewekoune kito ebon okannom. ‘Anutuŋo eŋane sotene nigetkaki qeliŋoniake, yale okane more mauluk ŋuniake.’
Anutuze eŋe wet maepine suaine pa maikane baŋ raki, wet maepine ea kepe qae qae yale qelaŋan ŋoniake, so wet maepine eaŋo eŋe mauluk ŋongi menaŋgene.
Anutuŋo qeliwo ŋine qelaŋanine maki sirike, seu seu wane panaman ruwitko gemami, yewa qelaŋanoniake, pakimo, sikanŋongi, peam wane numa wakongi, maine gesoke arikene.”

content: Pakiso, medep eŋe suakiso, Waom wano dereretineŋo yale waka suake, eŋe kepe yaup papaino gemageki, urata mamainane naso bomilekiso, Israel magu eŋano wakonge.
